study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Floris et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2021
study_identification_part.si4_title: Atypical Brain Asymmetry in Autism - A Candidate for Clinically Meaningful Stratification

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study explicitly states its objectives: to dissect heterogeneity in lateralization in autism using normative modeling to identify neural markers for stratification, and to relate these to clinical symptoms like language delay.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In order to dissect heterogeneity in lateralization in autism, we used the large EU-AIMS... dataset... using a promising approach that moves beyond mean group comparisons.... We derived gray matter voxelwise laterality values... and modeled individual deviations... using normative modeling.

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The reference cohort (neurotypical controls) is described. The EU-AIMS LEAP dataset is used. Exclusion criteria (MRI contraindications, sensory impairments, etc.) are detailed in the supplement. Final sample sizes are reported.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The final sample comprised 352 individuals with autism... and 233 neurotypical control subjects... Exclusion criteria included the presence of any MRI contraindications... significant hearing or visual impairments... missing T1-weighted MRI scans, low image quality... Neurotypical controls scoring positively for attention-deficit hyper-activity disorder (ADHD)... were also excluded.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.location: Floris2021.pdf.md: Participants; Floris2021_sup.pdf.md: Participants, study design and exclusion criteria

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The normative model included age, sex, and site as covariates.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: First, we trained a Gaussian process regression model at each voxel on the neurotypical cohort using age, sex, and site as covariates to predict gray matter asymmetry...

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The data source (EU-AIMS LEAP) is clearly specified. A replication dataset (ABIDE) is also used.
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: Participants were part of the EU-AIMS and AIMS-2-TRIALS LEAP (35,36) cohort... To assess replicability, we selected a sample from the publicly available Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and II...

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: Imaging modality (T1-weighted) and acquisition parameters (Table S1 in supplement) are described. Equipment specifications (scanners at 5 sites) are listed.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: High-resolution structural T1-weighted volumetric images were acquired with full head coverage, at 1.2-mm thickness with 1.2x1.2-mm in-plane resolution. For all other scanning parameters, please see Table S1.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.location: Floris2021_sup.pdf.md: MRI data acquisition; Table S1

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing using the CAT12 toolbox is described, including segmentation, registration to a symmetrical template (DARTEL), and smoothing.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: Structural T1-weighted images were preprocessed according to a validated laterality pipeline (17,47,48) using the CAT12 toolbox... All original images were segmented and affine registered to a symmetrical tissue probability map... DARTEL... Laterality images were smoothed with a 4-mm full width at half maximum isotropic Gaussian kernel.

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: 10-fold cross-validation was used within the neurotypical cohort to assess generalizability.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: To avoid overfitting, assess generalizability, and determine whether neurotypical individuals fall within the normative range, we used 10-fold cross-validation in neurotypical individuals...

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: While the study uses an external dataset (ABIDE) for replication, they appear to have trained a new normative model on the ABIDE controls rather than applying the LEAP-trained model to ABIDE. Thus, the LEAP normative model itself was not externally validated on an independent healthy cohort in the sense of model transfer.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: Next, normative modeling and the creation of normative probability maps were done in accordance with the primary imaging analysis in the main text.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.location: Floris2021_sup.pdf.md: Replication sample ABIDE I and II

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The statistical model is Gaussian Process Regression. Key settings (mean zero, covariance function) are described in the supplement. Software for normative modeling is not explicitly named (likely custom or PCNtoolkit), but 'pymatch' and 'CAT12' are mentioned for other steps.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: we estimated a normative brain aging model at each gray matter laterality voxel by using Gaussian process regression (53)... mean (m(x)) and covariance (k(x,x')) function... combined linear and nonlinear terms...
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.location: Floris2021.pdf.md: Normative Modeling; Floris2021_sup.pdf.md: Gaussian process regression

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: Model accuracy was evaluated using correlation between true and predicted values (Rho) and RMSE, shown in Figures S3 and S4.
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The accuracy of the normative model was evaluated using the correlation between the true and the predicted voxel values generated under 10-fold cross-validation... For unthresholded correlation maps along with root mean square error maps, see Figures S3 and S4.

cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.reason: Clinical covariates such as language delay (LD), ADHD, handedness, and symptom severity (ADOS, ADI-R) were considered in the analysis of deviation scores.
cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.supporting_text: The present study was designed to address heterogeneity in autism with regard to age, sex, handedness, and core and co-occurring symptoms... We ran relative importance analyses... including variables... such as LD, ADHD, handedness, sex, and Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule 2 calibrated severity score (CSS).

cr4_clinical_characteristics_clinical_co.supporting_text: The final sample comprised 352 individuals with autism... For details on demographic information, see Table 1.

cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.reason: Clinical measures (ADOS-2, ADI-R, ADHD rating scale, WASI) are described.
cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.supporting_text: IQ was assessed using the Wechsler Abbreviated Scales of Intelligence. The Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (44) measured clinical core symptoms... Autism Diagnostic Interview -Revised (ADI-R)... ADHD symptoms were assessed with the DSM-5 ADHD rating scale.

cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.reason: The interpretation of deviation scores (positive=rightward shift, negative=leftward shift) is explained. Extreme deviations are defined by a threshold (|Z|>2.6). Clinical implications (e.g., association with language delay) are discussed.
cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.supporting_text: Normative probability maps were thresholded at an absolute value of |Z| > 2.6... Based on this fixed threshold, we defined extreme rightward-lateralized (positive) and extreme leftward-lateralized (negative) deviations... The degree of atypical rightward lateralization may thus constitute a biological marker of different etiological subgroups...
